english: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=9\left\{\dfrac{x}{3}\right\}^{2}-6\left\{\dfrac{x}{3}\right\}$, where $\{t\}=t-[t]$ and $[t]$ denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to $t$. Let $g:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be an even function and $h:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be an odd function such that $f(x)=g(x)+h(x)$ for all $x\in\mathbb{R}$. Then the value of $h\left(\dfrac{37}{4}\right)$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, $f(x)=9\left\{\dfrac{x}{3}\right\}^{2}-6\left\{\dfrac{x}{3}\right\}$ द्वारा परिभाषित है, जहाँ $\{t\}=t-[t]$ तथा $[t]$, $t$ से कम या उसके बराबर महत्तम पूर्णांक को दर्शाता है। माना $g:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ एक सम फलन तथा $h:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ एक विषम फलन है जिनके लिए सभी $x\in\mathbb{R}$ के लिए $f(x)=g(x)+h(x)$ है। तब $h\left(\dfrac{37}{4}\right)$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: If $f=g+h$ with $g$ even and $h$ odd, then $f(-x)=g(x)-h(x)$, so $g(x)=\dfrac{f(x)+f(-x)}{2}$ and $h(x)=\dfrac{f(x)-f(-x)}{2}$; the decomposition is unique.

Let $s=3\left\{\dfrac x3\right\}$. Then $0\le s<3$, $x-s$ is a multiple of $3$, and $f(x)=s^{2}-2s$. Since $\left\{\dfrac{x+3}{3}\right\}=\left\{\dfrac x3\right\}$, $f(x+3)=f(x)$. No smaller positive period exists: a period $p\in(0,3)$ would need $f(p)=f(0)=0$, so $p=2$, but $f(1)=-1\ne0=f(3)$. So $3$ is the fundamental period and $f(x)=f(x-3k)$ for every integer $k$.

Therefore $h\left(\dfrac{37}{4}\right)=\dfrac12\left(-\dfrac{7}{16}-\dfrac{33}{16}\right)=\dfrac12\cdot\left(-\dfrac{40}{16}\right)=-\dfrac54=-1.25$. (For comparison, $g\left(\dfrac{37}{4}\right)=\dfrac{13}{16}$; the trap $f(-x)=-f(x)$ would give $-\dfrac{7}{16}$.)
originality_note: New: the odd part of a periodic function given through the fractional part {x/3}, so the period 3 is not stated and f(-x) must be reduced into a different point of the basic period (way 5). Closest known: writing a given algebraic function as the sum of its even and odd parts. Different because: f has neither parity, its period must be read from {x/3}, and the two reductions (37/4 to 1/4 and -37/4 to 11/4) land in different places.

key_step: h(x) = (f(x) - f(-x))/2 with both values reduced by the period 3 read from {x/3}.
justification: Routine chain of three standard steps (decomposition formula, period from the fractional part, evaluation at two reduced points) with no real insight. Comparable to 2025-P1-Q1 (L2), a direct function computation; numerical format.
blueprint_concepts: Even and odd functions; decomposition into even and odd parts

concept_use.Even and odd functions; decomposition in: The odd part is h(x) = (f(x) - f(-x))/2, by the unique decomposition of f into an even part g and an odd part h.
concept_use.Periodic functions: fundamental period: f(x) = s^2 - 2s with s = 3{x/3} has fundamental period 3, used to reduce f(37/4) to f(1/4) and f(-37/4) to f(11/4).
